hannah.name: Patty
hannah.relation: Hannah's lifelong best friend and inseparable counterpart. From classmates to teammates to clocking in at their very first job together, they've done just about everything side by side.

hannah.name: Sophie
hannah.relation: Liam's little sister, and very soon Hannah's too. One (of three!) bonus perks of marrying Liam.

hannah.name: Kelly
hannah.relation: Married to Hannah's brother, Max, so she's been a Lyons long enough to know exactly what she's getting herself into. Thankfully she said yes to this anyway.

hannah.name: Julia
hannah.relation: Liam's big sister and keeper of the groom's most embarrassing childhood stories. We suspect she's saving the best ones for the reception.

hannah.name: Katie
hannah.relation: Married to Liam's brother, Shawn, so she's already been through the whole "marrying into the Wilson family" thing and is here to show Hannah the ropes.

liam.name: Shawn
liam.relation: Liam's older brother, who has been showing him how it's done since day one. After years of big-brother advice, he gets one more turn at the mic.

liam.name: Max
liam.relation: Hannah's older brother, which makes him the only groomsman who got to vet the groom long before the rest of us. He signed off, and now he's standing on Liam's side.

liam.name: Brok
liam.relation: Married to Liam's little sister, Sophie, so he already knows what it takes to marry into the Wilson family. Consider him Liam's in-house expert on brothers-in-law.

liam.name: Will
liam.relation: Liam's friend since high school and husband to Patty, Hannah's matron of honor. That gives him a seat on both sides of the aisle, and he's spending it standing beside Liam.

liam.name: Ethan
liam.relation: Liam's friend from high school and Hannah's from college, which makes him the reason these two ever met. He was also Liam's landlord when they started dating, so he had a front-row seat from the very beginning.

liam.name: Tommy
liam.relation: A high school friend who has stuck by Liam through every phase, haircut and questionable decision since. We're counting on him for the dance floor.

liam.name: Matthew
liam.relation: Liam's friend since high school and Liam and Hannah's roommate for three years, which means he did more than his fair share of third wheeling. Now he finally gets to stand up front with them.

liam.name: Owen
liam.relation: Rounding out the high school crew, he's part of the group that's been around long enough to remember Liam before Hannah. He's thrilled with the upgrade.
